rootCause: BoardForge treated a clean compact fallback as REV_F completion while the true outline-aware placement board still had exact KiCad unconnected items. The first exact finishers also used representative DRC positions instead of resolving KiCad pad/track UUIDs to actual endpoints, and they lacked commit checkpointing.
fixSummary: Separate fallback manufacturing candidates from unfinished outline-aware boards. Add clearance-aware exact finisher planning and CLI execution that resolves DRC item endpoints, tests physical candidates with KiCad DRC, commits only when connectivity improves with zero DRC, checkpoints progress, adds a gated GND-zone connectivity repair for isolated return islands, removes redundant generated GND stubs transactionally after zones replace their connectivity role, and escalates to routeability-changing placement/rip-up when exact finishing is exhausted.

conditions: FreeRouting leaves a small exact ratsnest tail
DRC is clean but unconnected items remain
fallback route exists but product-shape route is not complete

recipe: Run KiCad DRC and parse unconnected_items.
Resolve each DRC item UUID to its actual pad or track endpoint.
Build a local obstacle map before generating route candidates.
Spend KiCad DRC only on candidates that pass geometric prefiltering.
Commit only when global unconnected decreases and DRC remains zero.
Checkpoint after every safe commit so long exact finishing can resume.

If a real physical exact-finisher batch rolls back every candidate because crossings/shorts dominate, stop burning DRC cycles and escalate to routeability-changing actions: controlled component nudge, bounded regional rip-up/reroute, or regenerated placement corridors.

Before routeability-changing placement, try a gated GND-zone connectivity repair on low-current synthetic fixtures: add a full-connect GND pour inside Edge.Cuts and keep it only if DRC remains zero and unconnected decreases.
After adding any copper candidate on a board with zones, refill zones before DRC. Stale filled zones can falsely reject valid candidates with clearance or crossing errors.
Parse KiCad DRC endpoints beyond simple pads/tracks, including PTH pad and via descriptions, otherwise the exact finisher silently skips legitimate unconnected items.
After a GND zone is committed, remove short redundant generated GND stubs in congested route windows only if KiCad proves DRC remains clean and unconnected does not increase.
safetyRules: Do not call a fallback board the same as the unfinished outline-aware board.
Do not export manufacturing for a board with unconnected items.
Do not count added segments as success.
Do not route with blind, buried, micro, or via-in-pad vias.
